description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a Quality Assurance professional to contribute to test planning, test design, and execution for web-based applications. The role includes validating APIs, managing defects, supporting clients, and collaborating with product and development teams to ensure application quality.
Software Engineer focused on web application and API testing, test planning, and defect management

Responsibilities:
• Contribute individually to test design, test planning, and test execution
• Develop test plans, test cases, and other testing documentation
• Test web-based applications using browser developer tools
• Validate API request and response data using browser developer tools
• Identify, document, and manage defects throughout the defect management process
• Work closely with product management and development teams to understand requirements and technical specifications
• Interact with clients regularly to understand business scenarios and provide testing and troubleshooting support
• Write basic database queries to support testing activities
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies
• Define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Meet deadlines and deliverables while adapting to changing priorities

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of relevant QA technical experience
• Experience working as part of an Agile/Scrum team
• Experience testing web-based applications and using browser developer tools
• Ability to develop test plans, test cases, and related test artifacts
• Familiarity with defect management processes
• Experience working with APIs and validating request and response data
• Ability to write basic database queries
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to collaborate across different functions and work effectively with clients, product teams, and developers
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Creative approach to troubleshooting technical problems
• Ability to focus on deadlines and deliverables
• Ability to think outside the box
• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills
• Adaptability and flexibility in a fast-paced work environment
• Attention to detail and a focus on quality and precision

Preferred:
• Knowledge of the health insurance domain is a strong plus
• Bachelor's degree (BS or BA) preferred
• Knowledge of advanced SQL and relational databases
• Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools
• Work authorization: United States preferred
